# cloudminator_subnet (Resource)

A subnet inside a VPC. `name`, `tags`, `snat` and `dhcp` change in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudminator_vpc" "main" {
  name   = "main"
  region = "eu-central-1"
}

resource "cloudminator_subnet" "app" {
  name   = "app"
  vpc_id = cloudminator_vpc.main.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name. Not unique.
- `vpc_id` (String) Parent VPC id.

### Optional

- `cidr` (String) IPv4 range within the VPC. Omit to allocate a /24.
- `dhcp` (Boolean) Serve DHCP on the subnet. Defaults to `true`.
- `gateway` (String) Gateway address. Defaults to the first host of the range.
- `org` (String) Organization slug. Defaults to the provider's `org`. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `project` (String) Project slug. Defaults to the provider's `project` (or `default`). Changing it forces a new resource.
- `snat` (Boolean) Source-NAT outbound traffic. Defaults to `true`.
- `tags` (Map of String) Key/value tags. Used by attribute-based access control, so a change can be denied if the new tags fall outside the caller's scope.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned subnet id (`subnet-…`).
- `phase` (String) Lifecycle phase reported by the platform (`Running`, `Stopped`, …).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a subnet by organization, project and subnet id.
terraform import cloudminator_subnet.app acme/default/subnet-0123456789abcdef01234567
```
